query.title: Search query
query.description: Keyword or exact phrase to search for across SEC filing text, e.g. "data breach" or "going concern".

forms.title: Form types
forms.description: Limit to these form types, e.g. "10-K", "8-K", "S-1". Leave empty to search all form types.

daysBack.title: Days back
daysBack.description: How many days back to search.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of matching filings to return, most recent first.
